parts.html: The K-36 kitchen is a modern L-shaped design that combines graphite upper cabinets, light gray lower fronts, and a tall light-colored section on the right. The contrast between the upper and lower tiers creates a striking two-tone composition, while the dark stone-look countertop ties all the elements together into a unified interior ensemble.

Unlike single-color kitchens, the K-36 is built on a combination of several closely related shades of gray. The graphite upper cabinets form a crisp horizontal line, the light gray lower fronts visually lighten the main body of the furniture, and the tall light-colored section on the right balances the composition.

In the visualization provided, the upper row includes open shelves alternating with closed cabinets. They can hold everyday items or small decorative pieces. Black horizontal handles echo the dark tone of the upper fronts and countertop.

The K-36 configuration is L-shaped. The furniture runs along two adjacent walls. This arrangement makes use of the corner space, distributes work surfaces between two sections, and provides convenient storage for kitchen utensils.

The total length of the kitchen is 4.1 linear meters. The overall dimensions of the standard composition are 4.1 × 2.4 × 0.6 m. In a custom design, the placement of the sink, cooktop, refrigerator, and other built-in appliances is determined based on the room dimensions and utility connections.
The standard model does not include a separate kitchen island. The main work surfaces, cabinets, and appliance spaces are organized within the L-shaped furniture composition.

Both upper and lower fronts are made of laminated chipboard. The upper row is finished mainly in graphite and dark gray, and the lower cabinets in light gray. The tall side section on the right also has a light finish.

The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard. The countertop is chipboard-based, with a dark decorative stone-look surface. This is a surface decor only: natural stone is not specified as the material of the standard countertop.
The standard K-36 configuration includes a cargo pull-out. It complements the regular cabinets with pull-out storage and keeps food and kitchen utensils organized and easy to reach.

Hinged cabinets are fitted with Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close mechanisms. Pull-out elements run on Muller telescopic slides without soft-close mechanisms. Cabinet handles are included. The standard model has no lift-up mechanisms.

The K-36 kitchen can be adapted in terms of functionality and materials. At the client’s request, more functional cabinet hardware, upgraded opening mechanisms, and additional storage systems can be installed. Alternative materials are also available, from more budget-friendly to premium options. With a custom order, you can change the combination of gray shades, choose different front and countertop materials, and adapt the cabinet interior fittings.

Additional options: more functional hardware, upgraded opening mechanisms, additional storage systems, and alternative materials from budget to premium. These solutions are selected separately and are not included in the stated standard configuration.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-36 can be adapted to the specific dimensions of your room by changing the length of the furniture runs and the placement of cabinets, work surfaces, and built-in appliances. During the design process, you can choose front and countertop materials, shades of gray, cabinet hardware, and interior storage systems.

We offer furniture design, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be supplied with a sink, faucet, range hood, and appliances.
Order the K-36 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and get a personalized quote based on your room dimensions and chosen configuration.
